hero.headline: UI systems, not components.
hero.subheadline: Bevel ships fully-engineered UI systems for your React app. Product Tour, Command Palette, File Upload, Form Engine — copy the code, own it forever.

differentiator.headline: A component gives you a button.
differentiator.subheadline: A system gives you the entire multi-step form.
differentiator.description: State machine. Per-step validation. Back/forward navigation. Error recovery. Progress persistence. Every edge case already handled. Every architectural decision already made. You just drop it in.

items.label: No installs
items.description: Copy the source directly into your project. No npm package to upgrade, ever.

items.label: No lock-in
items.description: You own the code. Change anything. Style it however your product needs.

items.label: shadcn compatible
items.description: Built on the same primitives. Drops straight into your existing setup.

systems.name: Product Tour
systems.description: Animated overlay, smart-positioned floating cards, media support, keyboard navigation, skip/resume. The architecture that takes a week to get right — already done.

systems.name: Command Palette
systems.description: Fuzzy search, two-tier tab filtering, grouped results, avatar support, keyboard shortcuts footer. Zero external search library.

systems.name: File Upload
systems.description: Drag-and-drop, per-file progress, cancel, retry, grid/list views, modal mode. The engine never touches your backend — you plug in your own upload logic.

systems.name: Form Engine
systems.description: Plugin system, react-hook-form integration, zod validation, conditional fields, custom layouts. Works as a multi-step wizard or a single-step form.

steps.title: Pick a system
steps.description: Browse the systems and find the one that solves your problem.

steps.title: Install with shadcn
steps.description: One command copies the source files directly into your project.

steps.title: Drop it in
steps.description: Import from your local components folder. Read the docs if you need to customise it.

steps.title: Own it forever
steps.description: The code is yours. No updates forced on you. No breaking changes. No vendor.

earlyAccess.headline: Get notified when systems ship.
earlyAccess.description: All four systems are in active development. Drop your email and you'll be the first to know when they're ready.
